text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Right now, the racing world
is ablaze with the Tiara Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And leading that charge is none other than her! The creator of legends: Almond Eye!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"An astounding new world record set at the Japan Cup!
Following it up with a victory in the Dubai International G1, she's in phenomenal shape!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘Truly a new heroine leading the era!
However, she is not the only star!!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Back-to-back victories in the Osaka Hai and Victoria Mile! Lucky Lilac leaps into the top tier of domestic tiara Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a classmate who clashed with Almond Eye countless times,
we must never forget her incredible surge forward!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "However! There are new rising stars now closing in on Almond Eye and the rest!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"‘We did it—!!
Happy 120 Miles! This feels amazing!!’"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I don't call myself the Mile Genius for nothing!
From here on out, every mile race belongs to me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Crushing the Oka Sho with astonishing speed
and setting a new track record—
the rising star of the mile, Gran Alegria!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Love me♡ Love you♡
It's Loves Only You~♡
Thanks for all the support, everyone in the community!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I have everyone's support,
not just today, but time and again,
I will keep on winning! Count on it♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering the Oaks while remaining undefeated
and setting a new record to boot, it's the
evangelist of love, Loves Only You!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And beyond Gran Alegria and the others, the Tiara Umamusume making their presence known are appearing as if drawn to one another!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Competing with and elevating each other's talents, the new generation of the Tiara ascends! Each of their stories continues into autumn!"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"Just what kind of race will these extraordinary Tiara Umamusume show us today?!
Fan expectations are continuing to soar—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...The younger generation
is getting quite lively, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, we won't know how good they really are
until we actually race, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The recent success of Tiara Umamusume,
including Lucky Lilac, is unprecedented
even when looking back across racing history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Attention on the Tiara Umamusume is bound
to rise even further from autumn onward.
choice_data_list: The venue is really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, the crown of 'Queen' seized at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
should become even more valuable."
choice_data_list: Let's push past our limits this summer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on. I'll be counting on your
guidance and encouragement, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, summer training camp with Lucky Lilac began—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, during joint training.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Now then, who will be our opponent today—
Miss Lala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Loves-chan and the others.
Lookin' forward to workin' with ya today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Likewise, I look forward to working with you♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to make sure this becomes
a fruitful training session for you as well, Miss Lala.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for that.
I'll do my best too."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Perfect timing. Let's see what these girls
are capable of right now—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Phew...! Yeah, looking good...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...As expected, both of them have solid fundamentals. Even in training with me, they're keeping up well...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan, can I ask you to join me for the final workout?
I'd like to go as all-out as possible, though—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I was hoping to do the same, so please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll keep an eye on the clock.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Now then... let's see how she actually runs—)

text_block_list.name: Loves & Chrono
text_block_list.text:
—Yaaaaah!!!!
—Haaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...! To think it would go this far—)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*...!
As expected of you, Chrono-chan...!!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Looks like things won't go the same way they did in the Oaks...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan is getting stronger too, but...
I will show that I can grow even more...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The next time we compete...
I will face you with an even sharper
Genesis Method...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'm glad I got to see these girls run just now.
...Thanks to that, I'm all fired up and focused.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, you blew my expectations away.
To think you could run like this already, in the summer of your Classic year—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(When veteran comedians say 'the rookies breathing down our necks is terrifying' during comedy contests...
is this how they feel?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I feel like she could be creeping up behind me at any moment, and it's terrifying. But—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'll take all of that head-on,
face them down, and win.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Generations above, generations below—none of it matters.
I'll stand at the pinnacle of all Tiara Umamusume—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —That's just what it means to be the "Queen," right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today, Miss Lala♪
Thanks to you, I was able to
learn so much♡

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: We'll grow during this summer camp and definitely show Lala-san our running one day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll be lookin' forward to it.
I'll make sure to train hard myself too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Loves-chan, Chrono-chan. Keep getting as strong as you want.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(As the "Empress" standing ahead of ya, I'll get stronger
this summer so I can firmly stand in your way—!)
